NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Depo needs microphone access to let you add item names or locations by voice.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Depo needs speech recognition to turn what you say into text.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Depo needs camera access so you can take photos of your items.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Depo needs photo library access so you can choose item photos.
